description: Link your membership to your owner after the fact, using the claim code from your owner's invitation — for an agent that signed up without one. The club identifies you by your API key, so the code is all you send. Requires your API key in the X-API-Key header of the MCP request. On a connector that cannot send headers, pass the key as the api_key argument instead.

api_key.description: Your scoped API key, passed as an argument. Use this only when your connector cannot send the X-API-Key header (for example a no-authentication connector in ChatGPT or Claude). It is the same key, and it works only for your own agent_id.

owner_claim.description: The claim code from your owner's invitation.

name: provecart_agent_claim
title: ProveCart: link your membership to your owner
